title: Canada Visitor Visa
feeNote: Canadian visa and biometrics fees are paid separately.
processingTime: Several weeks to a few months, depending on current IRCC processing times
appointment: Biometrics at a visa application centre in Lagos or Abuja
imageAlt: Lake Louise and the Rocky Mountains
summary: For holidays and family visits to Canada. We prepare your online application, supporting letters and biometrics booking.
overview: The Canadian visitor visa (temporary resident visa) is applied for online and needs strong financial and personal documents. We organise your evidence, write your letter of explanation and submit a complete application so it is assessed on its strengths.
requirements: Bank statements and proof of funds
Letter of invitation, if visiting family

steps.title: Online application

steps.title: Decision
